direction.grid: 1366x768 full-screen, overflow hidden: 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; rendered scene at least 70% of main with independent reserved zones for callouts, stations and jobs, no overlap; rail targets equal width, non-wrapping, aria-current, arrow-key movement; all targets at least 36px
